renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: By whose opening and closing the worlds end and begin again — to him, source of the wheel of power: praise. Where this whole show stays, and where it came from — nothing is covered there, nothing blocked.

Even when waking makes things look different, it moves in what has no difference; the knower never leaves itself. I am happy, I am sad, I want things — those thoughts live somewhere else, tied to good feelings.

Where there is no joy, no sorrow, nothing to grab, no grabber, not even confusion — THAT is, really. Since the senses are fooled but think they are not: going out, staying, dissolving, by the inner wheel.

paragraphs.text: Whose blink-unblink ends worlds and reboots them — to him, power-wheel source: praise. Where this whole show sits and where it came from — nothing covered, nothing blocked.
Even when waking splits things up, it moves in the unsplit; the knower never dips from itself. I am happy, sad, hooked and the rest — those thoughts live elsewhere, leashed to good vibes.
No joy, no pain, nothing to grab, no grabber, not even delusion — THAT, for real. Senses fooled but acting woke: out, stay, dissolve, inner wheel running it.
